data.name: Supriyo
data.gender_notes: Supriyo is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Supriyo is a Sanskrit and Bengali name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'suprī', meaning 'precious, dear, valuable, costly, rich'. It is a name that signifies prosperity and wealth, and is often given to boys as a symbol of hope and aspiration for a prosperous and successful future. The name Supriyo carries the meaning “Wealthy, Precious, Valuable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Supriyo usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, precious, valuable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Supriyo is a name with deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents the divine qualities of prosperity, loyalty, and intelligence. Those named Supriyo are believed to possess the ability to attract wealth and success, and are often seen as natural leaders and problem solvers.
data.etymology: Supriyo belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, Precious, Valuable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Supriyo total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
